description.text: Program OverviewThe degree considers the relationships between tourism and management systems, mechanisms for regional and community planning and development, and the role of tourism as a social, cultural and economic phenomenon. Students will be confident and competent to make contribution to tourism and tourism planning, and sensitive to the needs of tourism, tourism destination communities, industry and the visitor.Fee26,000 RMB per yearDuration4 yearsDegree AwardedQualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Tourism Management by Shandong University

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Shandong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.6. Certificate of No criminal record7. Scanned copies of the financial guatrantee materials8. Foreigner physical examiantion form Additional supplementary materials required by Shandong University

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport 4. With a good health and the age above 18.
